vehicles.encumbrance.title: Encumbrances
vehicles.encumbrance.intro: Holds on vehicles that this office recorded for their holders, and their release. Pending releases come first: a second person confirms them.
vehicles.encumbrance.amountHint: Optional. Birr, with up to two decimals.
vehicles.encumbrance.recordIntro: Write down the holder's letter. Your office acts for the holder: only your office can record its release.
vehicles.encumbrance.requestIntro: Write down the holder's release letter. The encumbrance stands until a second person confirms the release.
vehicles.encumbrance.confirmIntro: Check the release letter against the encumbrance. After you confirm, the vehicle is free of it.
vehicles.encumbrance.refuseIntro: Say why the release letter does not fit. The encumbrance stays open.
vehicles.encumbrance.banner: This vehicle carries an encumbrance: {holds}. Services that conflict with it are refused until the holder releases it.
